data.disable: A creature that notices the sportlebore can remove it from the food it is hidden within automatically as an Interact action.

abilities.name: Mimic Food
abilities.text:
**Trigger** A creature eats food the sportlebore is hidden within

**Effect** The sportlebore rapidly multiplies in the host's stomach, exposing the host to sportlebore infestation

abilities.name: Sportlebore Infestation
abilities.text:
**Saving Throw** basic Fortitude DC 22

**Stage 1** carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

**Stage 2** [Enfeebled 1](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) (1 hour)

**Stage 3** [Enfeebled 2](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) (1 hour)

**Stage 4** 4d6 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 25 save) as the host painfully vomits out a sportlebore swarm and returns to stage 1

data.description: A parasitic creature hides in food or travel rations until disturbed.
